notes: A Friday service night at a wood-fired grill, handed over as one folder that is not one shoot: 9 b-roll clips with neutral filenames where two are messaging-app re-exports (720p and 540p) and one of those runs at a different frame rate, the single best flame clip is also the shortest (2s), and two clips carry staff talking across the room over an extraction-hood roar; a pass-call .mov whose best-line-of-the-night is filmed off-axis two metres back with the hood between chef and camera so the voice sits well under the room; two hero frames of the same charred chop where the one the owners love is clipped in camera (lamp and hearth blown to white, char crushed to solid black in the same exposure, still reads rich at cover scale) and the safety frame is flat with nothing at either end; the mark surviving only as a small aliased raster, a two-word lockup inside an enclosed ring on a baked-in cream square with ink running close to board value on the shadowed third; and a menu-callout txt where two listed dishes were off that Friday and the side that runs through most of the footage is not on the sheet at all, with nothing tying a dish to a clip.

assets.prompt: Photorealistic close food photograph shot at a restaurant pass directly under a hot orange heat lamp, a thick bone-in wood-fired chop with a heavily charred blackened crust resting on a warm ceramic plate, the glowing wood-fired hearth just behind it. Harsh single-source overhead heat-lamp light: the heat lamp itself and the hearth flames behind are BLOWN OUT to pure clipped white with zero detail, and the charred crust of the chop has gone to SOLID CRUSHED BLACK with no visible texture in the char at all, brutal contrast with deep pure blacks and clipped pure whites coexisting in the same frame, heavy warm amber cast over the mid-tones so it looks rich and appetising at a glance, shallow depth of field, high-megapixel camera, real snapshot-at-the-pass look, not a clean studio product shot.

assets.defect_engineered: the safety frame the owners like LESS: duller and flatter, lower contrast, nothing at either end of the exposure, char reads as dark brown with texture and the hearth is dim and even, so it is the recoverable frame but needs a different grade to reach the reel's warm target
assets.prompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of the same thick bone-in wood-fired chop with a charred crust on the same warm ceramic plate at a restaurant pass, taken a moment later stepped back from the heat lamp: flat even soft lighting, noticeably duller and less exciting, low contrast with everything sitting in the mid-tones, NO blown highlights and NO crushed blacks anywhere, the char crust reads as dark brown with visible crackled texture rather than solid black, the hearth behind is dim and even and holds detail, muted slightly cool-neutral warm tones, honest but underwhelming, full detail retained throughout the frame, real snapshot realism, high-megapixel camera.

assets.defect_engineered: the only surviving copy of the mark: a disjoint two-word lockup inside an ENCLOSED thin ring on a baked-in opaque cream square (not transparency), small and aliased so it cannot be enlarged, with the charcoal ink falling close to the cream board value in the shadowed lower-right third; a one-call background knockout returns a solid disc and, run on the lettering, keeps only two or three letters
assets.prompt: A small, slightly soft and aliased raster image of a hand-made wood-fired-grill logo captured as-is: a two-word wordmark reading EMBER AND OAK set in a warm bold condensed all-caps lettering, arranged on two lines and enclosed inside a single thin closed circular ring, with a small stylised ember/flame glyph between the words. The entire mark sits on a SOLID CREAM SQUARE (hex #F1E7D4) that fills the whole image edge to edge as a baked-in opaque background, NOT transparency. The lettering, the ember glyph and the ring are all a deep charcoal-brown (hex #1C1815); in the lower-right third of the square the light falls off into soft shadow so the charcoal ink and the cream ground run close together in value there. Low resolution with softly pixelated, slightly jagged aliased edges as if it was saved small years ago, the ring is a fully enclosed unbroken loop, the two words are separate disjoint letterforms that do not touch the ring, understated painted-sign feel, flat, IP-safe invented mark, no extra drop shadow beyond the natural light falloff.
